summary: The autumn 2026 call of the Vienna BioCenter PhD Program in life sciences, in Vienna, Austria. It is for PhD applicants who hold a Master's or equivalent in a life sciences subject, or who expect to complete one within six months of the application deadline.
highlights: Requires a Master's or equivalent in a life sciences subject, or one expected within 6 months of the deadline.
Both referees must submit their references before the application can be finalised.
PhD program in life sciences at the Vienna BioCenter.
